completed: Memory preflight consulted O-39e0a74a6e1daec4 and O-315680b3def1d63c; reviewed all six requested inputs, the matched-ablation script, and prior planning/theory-audit qualifications. No code changes, experiments, or web browsing were performed.

Main, sensitivity, and empirical-population repeated-sampling stages are complete: 39 cells, seeds 1729/2027/7919, 103500 trial inputs, 3000 repetitions per main/empirical cell and 1500 per sensitivity cell. Four-worker CPU runtime was 39.0803 seconds; supplementary runtime was approximately 7.8 seconds as reported by the caller.

The original 14 methods plus two descriptive Hoeffding supplements yield 16 methods, 624 summary rows, 1248 paired rows, and 1656000 method-output rows. These are correlated outputs from 103500 trials, not 1656000 independent replications. Full raw integrity is reported complete by the caller; the independent audit checked all summary aggregations and selected raw files, not every raw row independently.

The declared 180 exact-coverage bounds, 72 designated width tests, and 252 asymptotic-undercoverage tests were audited. Nine designated width tests reject after joint Holm adjustment, all in sharp_tails; 31 asymptotic-undercoverage tests reject. At sharp_tails n=500, N=10000, safeCP/PPI++ mean-width ratio is 0.734872, or 26.51% narrower, with pointwise MC95 reduction interval [26.28%,26.75%].

Negative and empirical controls establish substantive limitations: safeCP is 51.3–54.8% wider than PPI++ on forest and 86.2–88.4% wider on galaxies; rare-event PPI++ coverage is 0.626 at n=100; shifted n=500 PPI++ coverage is zero with clipping-induced point intervals. These findings remain in the report, not exclusions or tuning targets.

The post-audit matched-response-budget known-mass ablation is complete and exploratory. At sharp_tails n=500 and N/n=1,5,20,100, paired unknown-minus-matched widths are 0.1097525, 0.0487986, 0.0243132, 0.0108514, with MCSEs 0.00001991, 0.00000833, 0.00000303, 0.00000188. The additional matched-minus-reallocated response-budget gap is approximately 0.00327 throughout.
unmet_success_signals: Paper/report synthesis and claim-to-artifact traceability remain to be finalized; the evidence supports a conditional audit and specialized width gains, not novel universally optimal inference or deployment validation.
Documentation must reconcile the completed post-audit exploratory ablation with the frozen audit's earlier recommendation and its then-correct statement that no matched ablation had been executed.

A consolidated provenance record still needs verification of exact launch commands, input/code/data hashes, empirical-dataset and provided-predictor provenance, package versions, thread settings where recorded, supplementary chronology, and matched-ablation trial pairing.

Fallback/nonfinite counts, preclipping endpoints, and per-method timings are not available in the inspected summaries. Endpoint integrity does not establish zero fallback use. Floating-point outward padding and simulation checks do not certify special-function error. These are disclosure limitations, not requirements to modify code or collect new outcomes.

stage_modifications.change: Close execution and aggregation gates using the completed integrity record; replace the obsolete 14-method expected-row count with 1656000 total method-output rows including supplements. Preserve all trials, seeds, unfavorable cells, and existing results. Distinguish caller-reported full raw integrity from the independent audit's six-cell raw reread. No reruns or additional outcome-selected confirmatory experiments are recommended.

Keep the manifest unchanged: five feasible exact methods across 36 nonshift cells give 180 simultaneous coverage bounds; two designated pairs give 72 jointly Holm-adjusted width tests; seven asymptotic methods give 252 jointly Holm-adjusted lower-tail coverage-hit tests. Shift, unsafe/oracle procedures, Hoeffding supplements, and the post-audit matched ablation do not enter these families. Describe confirmatory status as declared by the manifest; supplied artifacts alone do not independently establish lock timing. Width tests are asymptotic paired-mean tests; Holm does not make them exact or their ratio intervals simultaneous.

Mark the matched-response-allocation diagnostic complete, not pending. Report three columns: unknown masses, known masses with matched alpha/(2K) response budgets, and known masses with reallocated alpha/K budgets. At N/n=20 these widths are 0.0537950, 0.0294818, 0.0262068, separating mass gap 0.0243132 from reallocation gap 0.0032750. This decomposition concerns the fixed tails procedure in four sharp-tail cells, not the safe selector or general mass-estimation cost. Label it post-audit exploratory, retain paired MCSEs as descriptive, and append chronology without rewriting the original audit or manifest.

State the finite-sample CP/box-simplex guarantee conditional on independent iid labeled/unlabeled sampling from the same population, partitions independent of both evaluation samples, empty-cell conventions, and simultaneous candidate error allocation. Safe selection is among four alpha/4-corrected candidates, not ordinary unadjusted intervals. Separate the real-arithmetic theorem from implementation/numerical certification. Restrict oracle optimality to the stated deterministic-control variance family; require partition refinement, not merely more bins, for approximation improvement. For full-data learned means on fixed bins, state fixed K, positive active masses, scaled variance consistency and nondegenerate limiting variance, with separate degeneracy treatment; do not claim arbitrary learned boundaries, finite-sample fitted-estimator unbiasedness, or general shift robustness. Reconcile source notes and disclose the implemented ddof=1 convention without new browsing.

Archive the recorded launch command with '--workers 4', seeds, metadata, environment and source/data hashes, plus supplementary and exploratory-ablation scripts, summaries and raw artifacts. Metadata records Python 3.11.15, NumPy 2.4.6, SciPy 1.17.1 and pandas 3.0.6. Verify existing key-complete trial pairing for the ablation and record chronology without generating new samples. Report aggregate wall time only, not per-method speed rankings. Mark absent thread settings, fallback counters or preclipping diagnostics unavailable rather than inferring them.

new_stages.title: Final conditional-audit report and paper handoff
new_stages.goal: Produce a reproducible, bounded account of the completed evidence without changing methods, outcomes, families, or research claims.
success_signals: Every numerical claim links to a keyed table row or audit artifact; benefits, real-data penalties, rare-event failures and shift failures receive comparable visibility.

The exact-family minimum observed coverage 0.943333 and simultaneous lower bound 0.927341 are reported correctly; neither observed coverage nor non-rejection is called a proof of validity. Zero misses in 3000 trials is not true coverage one.

Pointwise MC intervals, simultaneous MC bounds, data-level coverage guarantees and adjusted width tests are explicitly distinguished. Undefined zero-reference-width ratios remain undefined; numerical p-value underflow is not literal p=0.

Forest/galaxies results are described as with-replacement experiments conditional on fixed empirical populations and predictions, not independent deployment validation or predictor-training uncertainty.

The final report contains a dated exploratory-ablation addendum, provenance inventory and explicit unavailable-diagnostics/numerical-certification limitations; no universal optimality, global crossover threshold or general shift-robustness claim remains.
what_to_run: No new experiments, code modifications, or web searches. Assemble tables and figures only from existing summary.csv, paired.csv, mass_ablation_summary.csv and audited artifacts.

Perform a documentation-only consistency review of manuscript/report, theory notes, design addendum, manifest and provenance; correct 'upper-tail undercoverage' wording to lower tail of coverage hits, equivalently upper tail of misses.
